slides.title: Choose Your Bold Aesthetic
slides.context: Four bold, geometric, high-impact directions inspired by your selection of Constructivist. Each maintains your core Tesla/AI/Robotics content.

options.label: Bauhaus Modernist
options.description: Primary colors and geometric purity — circles, triangles, functional design
options.aside:
Inspired by the Bauhaus movement, Kandinsky, and functionalist design.

• Primary palette: pure red (#dc2626), blue (#2563eb), yellow (#facc15), black
• Basic geometric shapes as design elements — circles, triangles, rectangles
• Asymmetric balance with mathematical precision
• Grid-based layouts with intentional breaking points
• Functional typography (Jost, Futura, Bauhaus-style fonts)
• White space used as an active design element

Timeless, intellectual, and universally respected design tradition.

options.label: Tokyo Graphic
options.description: Extreme verticality, kanji energy, massive contrast, international typographic style
options.aside:
Inspired by Japanese graphic design, 葛西薫 (Kasai Kaoru), and Japanese magazine culture.

• Extreme vertical rhythm — 90px headlines with 9px body text
• Vertical text elements alongside horizontal
• Limited palette: ink black (#1a1a1a) with one accent (vermillion #dc4c4c or indigo #4a6741)
• Massive contrast between filled and empty space
• Bold sans-serifs with geometric precision (Hiragino, Yu Gothic)
• Information-dense but breathable layouts

Sophisticated, international, and deeply considered visual hierarchy.

options.label: Art Deco Metropolis
options.description: Machine Age luxury with gold, black, sunbursts, and streamlined geometry
options.aside:
Inspired by 1920s Art Deco, Metropolis (1927), and the Machine Age aesthetic.

• Luxurious palette: deep black (#0a0a0a), champagne gold (#d4af37), cream (#f5f5dc)
• Sunburst rays, streamlined curves, stepped patterns
• High contrast geometric ornamentation
• Vertical emphasis with skyscraper proportions
• Elegant condensed serif or geometric sans-serifs
• Symmetry with controlled asymmetry for visual interest

Projects ambition, sophistication, and timeless elegance.

options.label: Industrial Factory
options.description: Raw steel, riveted metal, stenciled typography, safety yellow warning aesthetics
options.aside:
Inspired by industrial revolution, factory signage, and raw engineering materials.

• Raw palette: steel gray (#4a4a4a), warning yellow (#facc15), hazard black, rust orange
• Stenciled typography like crate markings and machinery plates
• Riveted borders, metal textures, stamped effects
• Technical specification layouts — data plate aesthetic
• OSHA-style warning stripes and safety markings
• Functional, no-nonsense information design

Shows you build real things that work in the real world.
